string-array.name: help_atf_temp
string-array.item: Usually 70–95 °C. Higher in traffic, in hot weather and with spirited driving.
Staying above 120 °C means the transmission is overheating. If on your usual route it runs hotter than it used to, check the fluid level and condition.

string-array.name: help_gear
string-array.item: The gear the transmission module has engaged.
1–6 (or however many gears the box has) going forward.
If the screen shows a different gear from the real one, look at the gear ratio: it tells the gear for sure.

string-array.name: help_gear_ratio
string-array.item: Gear ratio: transmission input shaft speed divided by output shaft speed. Worked out from those two, shown only while moving.
At a steady pace it sits on one number, different for each gear. On a GM 6L50, for example: 4.065, 2.371, 1.551, 1.157, 0.853, 0.674, reverse 3.200. In-between values during a shift.
Wanders in one gear or rises when you press the gas: looks like clutch slip. Read the transmission module codes and check the fluid.

string-array.name: help_tcc_slip
string-array.item: Torque converter slip: how much faster the engine turns than the transmission input shaft.
Noticeable when accelerating and in town, while the converter clutch is unlocked. Stopped in D on the brake, almost equal to engine rpm. Close to zero at a steady pace with the clutch locked.
Never gets near zero at a steady pace: the clutch doesn\'t lock. Jumps with the clutch locked: a worn clutch. Read the transmission module codes (P0741, for example).

string-array.name: help_input_shaft
string-array.item: Transmission input shaft speed, which is the torque converter turbine.
A little below engine rpm in P and N. 0 when stopped in D on the brake.
Far from engine rpm in P/N, or drops out while driving: the input shaft speed sensor (codes P0716, P0717).

string-array.name: help_output_shaft
string-array.item: Transmission output shaft speed, rises with vehicle speed.
0 when stopped. Its ratio to vehicle speed is the same in every gear.
Drops out while driving: the output shaft speed sensor (code P0722).
